capabilities: Show elapsed-time labels for boolean properties in daily notes
Detect the daily notes folder and date format from core Daily Notes settings
Filter which boolean property keys are annotated
Configure label style and optional custom folder/format
disambiguation: It does not modify notes or property values; it only displays read-only annotations.
extras: README covers manual installation only and includes no screenshots or usage examples.
problem: Daily notes record boolean properties, but Obsidian shows no indication of how long it has been since a property was last true.
summary: Display-only annotator that shows labels like '3 days since last' next to boolean properties in daily notes.
